QUOTE: Gate not defined (the default for outside code): `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`. The real member is renamed... Gate defined: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `member`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that by default the macro renames the member to `private_##member`, and that defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` makes it expand to the unchanged member name.
